newsitem.title: RUSSIA: New IMF mission in Moscow to mull loan payout.
newsitem.headline: New IMF mission in Moscow to mull loan payout.

text.p: A mission from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) started working in Moscow on Tuesday to assess whether to pay delayed tranches of its $10 billion loan to Russia, the fund's chief representative in Moscow Thomas Wolf said on Tuesday.
Wolf told Reuters the mission would review Russia's economic indicators for November and the data for the first half of December, its general macroeconomic performance and restructuring of industry.
It will also make a preliminary assessment of the terms of the 1997 programme, Wolf said.
He said he expected the mission to complete its work on Saturday, but said the IMF was unlikely to make a decision on whether or not to pay the tranches before the New Year.
Wolf said the IMF had another two missions working in Moscow to advise on improving tax collection, banking supervision and restructuring in the banking sphere.
